title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.20936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. translated_title: 面向连续控制中形态参数泛化的图算子世界模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20936v1 公告类型：新 摘要：连续控制中的世界模型通常针对固定物理系统进行训练，当已知形态参数（如连杆长度、质量、阻尼和驱动）发生变化时，模型性能可能下降。现有方法通常将这些参数作为条件信息提供，但未明确学习到的转移中哪些部分应保持可复用，哪些部分应随形态变化。我们提出图算子世界模型（GraphOp-WM），一种用于相关铰接机器人家族内未见形态参数泛化的结构化世界模型。GraphOp-WM将身体及其运动学关系表示为属性图，并将每次转移分解为形态无关的局部动力学基和形态条件的结构化算子。该算子结合了节点局部调制、运动学树耦合和低秩全局校正，而架构信息分离和基范数...
tldr: 本文提出GraphOp-WM，一种通过将世界模型转移分解为形态无关基和形态条件算子，实现连续控制中跨未见形态参数泛化的结构化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GraphOp-WM, a structured world model that factorizes transitions into morphology-independent basis and morphology-conditioned operators to achieve generalization across unseen morphology parameters in continuous control.
